provenance: Estimated from four photographs of a LinkerHand G20 left hand under indoor lighting (2026-11-10). Values are visual estimates, not measured reflectance.

shell_silver.parts: Pearl-silver painted shell: palm and dorsal housing, dorsal cover, finger dorsal covers, thumb shells, thumb-root cover

rubber_black.parts: Matte black rubber: diamond-textured palm pad, ribbed finger and thumb pads, dorsal teardrop inserts

steel_link.parts: Stainless linkage: finger mount lugs, metacarpal brackets, middle-segment frames, distal link plates, thumb pins and bearings

steel_dark.parts: Dark steel plates inside the thumb root, mostly hidden
